verdict.rationale: Drata publishes a documented public API v2 with OAuth setup, extensive endpoint reference (Personnel, Devices, Controls, Risks, Audits, Custom Connections, Monitoring Tests, Policies), covering core compliance workflows programmatically. Missing for 10: no independently verifiable OpenAPI spec file (probe found 404s at expected paths) and no llms.txt/machine-readable doc discovery, reducing confidence in AI-agent-friendliness despite explicit marketing claims about AI agent interaction.
